at: The house and the three who stayed.
alt: Close intro-card: Sunduk’s face large, Yongsu beside her, the house watching the mouth.
scene: PAINTED INTRO-CARD, not a class photo, not a cel dump. INTIMATE CLOSE: old Queen Sunduk’s FACE FILLS the left third — match LEFT sheet face exactly (eye shape, grey hair, gold crescent, rust silk). LOW three-quarter, slight dutch. ONE DEVICE: a rust-red #9a3b2a silk ribbon of steam cutting diagonally. Beside her, closer than the others: old Yongsu WHITE hair, one stray white strand, cream-and-blue silk, living BLACK eyes — FOURTH sheet face. Midground bokeh, painted not lined up: Sungman salmon-peach (SECOND) and Chunmyung lavender (THIRD). Foreground dark shoulders: Jesang, Gildal HUMAN rust silk, On Gunhae. Munmu a tiny speck in a warm oval of first light, upper right. Jewel-tone colour: rust, salmon, lavender, cream blooming into the wash; wet-stone catch, paper grain, visible brush. Faces drawn webtoon, world PAINTED. They look toward the mouth, not the lens. One of each. No body halo. No text.

alt: Close two-shot: Chunchu and adult Gotaso, Yushin behind them, watching Munmu leave.
scene: PAINTED INTRO-CARD. INTIMATE TWO-SHOT, faces LARGE. OVER-SHOULDER from the water, slight dutch. ONE DEVICE: Chunchu’s magenta #D8258C sleeve as a hard painted band across the lower third. King Chunchu (FOURTH sheet) LEFT-of-center, face LARGE, magenta silk, hand on ADULT Gotaso’s shoulder. Gotaso ~40 (FIFTH sheet) RIGHT-of-center, FACE BONES from the girl portrait GROWN — same eyes and mouth, gilt butterfly binyeo, pink chima, never a child. Behind them, midground: old Yushin #2A5FB8 (THIRD sheet) standing, face readable. Far bokeh: Muryuk cone helm purple (LEFT), Seohyeon blue (SECOND). Munmu a speck in a pale mouth behind Yushin’s shoulder. Jewel colour: magenta, pink, marshal blue blooming into painted steam. Match sheet faces exactly. World PAINTED, faces inked. One of each. No kneeling lineup. No text.

alt: Worm’s-eye: Sadaham’s face huge in the foreground, the first-yard hwarang watching the aisle.
scene: PAINTED INTRO-CARD. WORM’S-EYE from the black water, HARD DUTCH. ONE DEVICE: the aisle as a pale painted seam racing to the mouth. FOREGROUND: Sadaham’s FACE HUGE at the left edge — ice-blue silk, crescent headband, LEFT sheet face copied exactly, looking down-aisle not at us. Midground receding on the left bank: Mugwan steel-blue (SECOND), Gwisan green (THIRD). Right bank receding: Chuhang (FOURTH), Bangul (FIFTH), Gwanchang (SIXTH) — six different men, never clones. Munmu a tiny winter-coat speck in the mouth, NO crown in the ranks. Jewel colour: ice-blue, green, white-silk catching lamp, steam blooming #6fa8ff into the wash at one edge. Faces inked, cavern PAINTED watercolor-and-oil, paper grain. Only six hwarang plus the speck. No front lineup. No text.

alt: Close on the three hill sisters in the water; the founders small on the far ledge.
scene: PAINTED INTRO-CARD. INTIMATE THREE-SHOT of the hill sisters, faces LARGE in the central band. LOW from the water. ONE DEVICE: the mirror waterline as a cyan-and-ember painted stroke. FOREGROUND: Golhwa orange #e86820 CENTER, legs open on wet rock, hiked chima, wanting face (#7 sheet). Hyullé cyan #2eb8c4 RIGHT, knees pressed, shy wrecked face (#8). Narim green #3d9e52 LEFT, breathless (#6). White jeogori, character-color chima, matching binyeo. Magical cavern steam: ember motes, water-luminescence, floating leaf-light — the CAVE is coloured, not a body halo. FAR ledge small: Dangun apex, Hyukgose and Alyoung REDRAWN as painted webtoon (SECOND, THIRD), Suro purple far left (LEFT), Heo deep-brown skin purple silk far right (FOURTH). Munmu a speck in the mouth. Jewel colour, visible brush, paper grain. Match sister faces to the sheet. One of each. No sitting class photo. No text.

at: Behind him the cave is full.
alt: Painting: Munmu walks the aisle, the named dead in depth along the banks.
scene: PAINTED INTRO-CARD wide, not a graphic black poster, not a yearbook. SLIGHT DUTCH, LOW from the water behind him. ONE DEVICE: the aisle as a wet crimson reflection of his coat. Munmu SMALL, BACK three-quarter, mid-stride AWAY, winter coat #C41E3A, WET hair, NO crown. The dead stand in DEPTH along the banks — overlapping, some closer, some dissolving into painted steam — NEVER a flat even rank, NEVER facing the lens. Colour BLOOMS: rust and salmon on the left bank, ice-blue and green on the right, magenta and pink near Chunchu and Gotaso, orange/cyan/leaf steam at the far goddesses. Faces from the 7-across grid (copy FACES only, ignore extra hands). Jewel-tone wash, visible brush, paper grain at the edges. One of each. They watch. No text.

at: They do not follow. They watch.
alt: Over Sunduk’s shoulder: her face large, the dead receding, Munmu in the mouth.
scene: PAINTED INTRO-CARD. OVER-SHOULDER CLOSE, not a face grid, not a horseshoe class photo. Sunduk’s FACE LARGE in the left foreground — rust silk, gold crescent, LEFT-of-grid row 1, looking toward the mouth, we see her cheek and eye. Rack-focus: Chunchu magenta and adult Gotaso pink as a sharp pair on the right third. Everyone else recedes in painted planes and steam, faces smaller, overlapping, not a tidy chart. ONE DEVICE: the mouth as a warm paper-white oval, Munmu a small winter-coat figure walking away, wet hair, NO crown. Jewel colour blooming from her rust silk into the wash. Faces from the 7-across grid, FACES only. World PAINTED. One of each. They watch. No horses. No text.
